english: Passively grants 20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed from 8 to 8.5 meters per second, and increases Slide Distance from 6.5 to 8.5 meters.

source.text:
4 Piece | Sublime Transit

Passively grants +20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed from 8 m/s to 8.5m/s, and increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.
